prerequisites: Basic knowledge of computer science and electronics

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamental principles of electronic measurements, experimental data acquisition and processing methodologies, the characteristics of electronic measurement instruments, and the main signal processing techniques.
Understand the concepts of measurement uncertainty and the main sources of error in measurement processes.

Apply the acquired knowledge to perform measurements using digital electronic instrumentation, acquire and process signals, analyze experimental data, and evaluate the uncertainty associated with measurement results.
Use appropriate methods and tools to address basic measurement problems in engineering applications.
Critically evaluate measurement results, interpret experimental data, identify the main sources of error, and assess the reliability of the obtained results.
Select the most appropriate measurement methods and instruments according(to the specific problem under consideration.
Clearly and rigorously communicate the adopted methodologies, experimental results, and related analyses using appropriate technical and scientific terminology.
Present and discuss measurement results through graphs, tables, and technical reports.

Develop the ability to independently expand their knowledge in the field of electronic measurements, understand the operation of new measurement instruments and techniques, and continuously update their skills in response to technological developments in data acquisition and signal processing.

syllabus_topics: Statistic methods for the analysis of experimental data
Analogue and digital electronic instrumentation (voltmeters, ammeters, multimeters, counters)

assessment_methods.method: Oral exam (2 questions related to the course syllabus)

assessment_rules: The final exam is an oral interview. The assessment considers the relevance of answers, quality of content, mastery of technical language, ability to connect topics, and ability to provide examples. Students with valid certifications for DSA, disabilities, or other educational needs should contact the teacher before the assessment to agree on adapted methods.
